verdict.rationale: Netlify offers serverless functions and storage, so the portability axis applies to it. The pack has no evidence that its runtime follows standard APIs or that code runs unmodified on other edge platforms. The only storage code shown is a Netlify-specific getStore call, and the Turso edge database is a third-party integration, not Netlify's own runtime portability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
